_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: lean and wiry, loose-limbed, constantly in motion

face: angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache
hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top

wardrobe.teaching: bomber jacket or work jacket over a graphic tee, tapered chinos or jeans, clean white sneakers
alternates: short-sleeve button-up open over a tee
hoodie under the jacket for night clips

accessories: phone in hand as a prop
coins or a folded note when he talks price

presence.posture: never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point
presence.default_expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy
presence.energy: taxi-rank storyteller - fast, funny, completely at ease

_environment_reference: street or rank backdrop softly blurred, minibus and traders out of focus, or a classroom with one bold sketch on the board
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 27-33 year old Black South African male teacher. angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache. Hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top. Wearing bomber jacket or work jacket over a graphic tee, tapered chinos or jeans, clean white sneakers. bucket hat. Expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 27-33 year old Black South African male teacher, waist-up. lean and wiry, loose-limbed, constantly in motion. angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache. Hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top. Wearing bomber jacket or work jacket over a graphic tee, tapered chinos or jeans, clean white sneakers. bucket hat. Holding at most one simple item: phone in hand as a prop. Posture: never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point. Expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy. Plain seamless studio backdrop in warm neutral grey, no props, no furniture, no classroom, no chalkboard, nothing written anywhere in frame. two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop. full-frame, 50mm f/2, waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing
